security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real risk around community-skill external command instructions and API-key handling. Many static hits are Markdown fence or documentation false positives, including source links, setup links, and exit-code text. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration language was found in SKILL.md, but the relative script workflow and Gemini data sharing remain sensitive.

remediation.issue: Relative script execution is documented, but the referenced script is not included in the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the script in the package or require an explicit skill-local path with integrity verification before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill requires a Gemini API key and suggests storing it in a .env file.
remediation.suggestion: Document secret handling, redaction, least-privilege keys, and safer environment-variable setup without committed .env files.

remediation.issue: The documentation does not clearly warn that research topics may be sent to an external AI service.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note that users should avoid confidential topics or obtain approval before sending data to Gemini.

content.value_statement: Research tasks can take time and require organized prompts, status checks, and cited synthesis. This skill documents a Gemini Deep Research workflow for planned reports, streaming progress, follow-up research, and structured outputs.
actual_capabilities: Documents when to use Gemini Deep Research for market, competitive, literature, technical, and due diligence research.
Shows setup steps for a Gemini API key and a local environment variable.
Provides CLI examples for starting, streaming, checking, waiting, continuing, and listing research tasks.
Describes default, structured, JSON, and raw output formats.
Sets expectations for run time, cost, and token usage.
limitations: The audited package only contains SKILL.md; the referenced research script is not present.
Use requires a Gemini API key and may send research queries to an external service.
Reported costs and token usage are estimates and can vary by task.
The skill documentation does not define safeguards for sensitive research topics.

use_cases.title: Compare Market Segments
use_cases.description: Create a cited report on market size, trends, competitors, risks, and open questions for a new opportunity.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Options
use_cases.description: Compare frameworks, platforms, or architecture choices with strengths, weaknesses, tradeoffs, and recommended next steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Due Diligence Briefs
use_cases.description: Gather background, timelines, public signals, and unresolved risks before a partnership, acquisition, or investment review.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research to create a cited overview of [topic]. Include key facts, current trends, major sources, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research to compare [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Cover strengths, weaknesses, costs, risks, and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Market Landscape
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research to analyze the [market] landscape. Include customer segments, key competitors, pricing signals, growth drivers, risks, and cited evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Run Iterative Due Diligence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research for due diligence on [company or topic]. Start with a structured report, then continue with follow-up questions about unresolved risks.

output_examples.output: A cited report with a timeline, major releases, ecosystem milestones, adoption patterns, and remaining research questions.

output_examples.input: Compare Python web frameworks for a new internal service.
output: Executive summary with a recommended framework.
Comparison of maturity, ecosystem, performance, developer experience, and deployment fit.
Risk notes and questions for the engineering team.

output_examples.input: Analyze the electric vehicle battery market.
output_examples.output: A market brief covering demand drivers, supply constraints, major companies, technology trends, costs, and cited source notes.

best_practices: Review research topics for confidential information before sending them to the external AI service.
Use structured report sections when the user needs comparison or decision support.
Track cost, time, and interaction identifiers for long-running research tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys in shared chat, committed files, or public logs.
Do not run the referenced script from an untrusted working directory.
Do not use raw output for final user reports without review and formatting.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It documents a Gemini Deep Research workflow for longer research tasks that need planning, search, synthesis, and citations.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions require a Gemini API key in an environment variable before use.

faq.question: Can it stream progress?
faq.answer: The documentation includes a streaming mode so users can monitor long-running research tasks.

faq.question: What outputs does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes human-readable reports, structured report sections, machine-readable output, and raw API responses.

faq.question: Is the referenced script included?
faq.answer: No. This audited package only includes SKILL.md, so users should verify any script before running it.

faq.question: Should I use it for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use caution. Research topics and source material may be sent to an external AI service.
